• Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data (source: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain).
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion): pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026: Combined Summary
